stage: target-7 optimization pilots; final timing campaign remains gated
formulation: Axisymmetric Taylor-Hood momentum and residual-weighted P1 thermal equation, including cylindrical strong diffusion, integrated P2 trial advection, weighted storage, source and background. Exact coupled derivatives; backward-Euler optimization.

pilot_policy.checkpoint: every retained nonlinear iterate; no automatic cap extension
pilot_policy.device: matched hybrid CPU vectors and GPU block/coarse work after memory screening
pilot_policy.scope: Independent pilots proceed concurrently with old-control resolution diagnostics. Their fields, failures and timings remain distinct from older formulations. No completed-solve ratio from capped runs.

conservation.acceptance: Independently reassembled momentum, weak continuity and thermal residuals; integrated external volume flux and discrete thermal-energy balance.
conservation.local_diagnostics: Independent P2 face integration, cylindrical divergence theorem, interior-face cancellation, net flux per element and divergence RMS. Continuous P1 pressure imposes weak continuity, not exact cellwise conservation.
conservation.correction_policy: Diagnose significant local defects before changing transport or reconstructing velocity. Any such discretization change requires its own derivative, adjoint, conservation and optimization verification.

resolution.time_transfer: piecewise-constant saved source; exact interval boundaries
resolution.stop_rule: Two non-improving refinement comparisons require diagnosis, not a larger cap or relaxed tolerance.
resolution.margin_K: max(0.01, 2*(e_t+e_h)); at most 0.1; reoptimize and reassess the new source independently

final_campaign.status: not authorized by pilot completion alone; requires resolution and physical-bound gates
final_campaign.recycling: Jacobi-scaled selection retaining existing coarse vectors and new Krylov information; transfer and update costs included
final_campaign.comparison: Each alpha is a separate problem group. Match criteria, device, starts and declared rank/memory policy; rotate method order. Charge every attempt, construction, solve, transfer, verification and cleanup; preparation separately.
final_campaign.interpretation: Evidence validity does not depend on the sign of the measured speedup. Only matching completed solutions support speedup claims.
